steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ with username 'admin' and password 'bench-admin-pass'. If a login form appears, fill the username and password fields and submit. Verify you end up signed in (e.g. dashboard/home page loads, no login form remains) and report what page you are on.

02-find: Navigate to the Opportunities list view (e.g. via the Opportunities tab in the navbar). Find all opportunities whose Name starts with 'Seed:' and report each name EXACTLY as shown in the list, one per line. Do not modify anything. If the list is paginated, check all pages. Report the exact names.

03-create: Create a new Opportunity record in EspoCRM with these exact values: Name = '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'; Account = 'Bench Account' (this is a link field — you must actually select the record 'Bench Account' from the suggestions dropdown or select dialog, not just type it; other accounts have similar names so pick the exact one named 'Bench Account'); Assigned User = 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — actually select the user named exactly 'Bench Assignee' from the suggestions/select dialog); Stage = 'Negotiation'; Amount = 12500 (leave currency as the default); Close Date = 2026-12-31; Description = 'Bench opportunity created for run {{runid}}'. Save the record. Then verify by reopening the record and report: the name, the linked account shown, the assigned user shown, the stage, the amount, the close date, and the description text.

04-find: On the opportunity record page at {{03-create.url}} (named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'), find the {{01-signin.page_heading_1}} panel and post a new message whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench stream post for run {{runid}}'). Submit the post so it appears in the {{01-signin.page_heading_1}}. Then verify the post is visible in the {{01-signin.page_heading_1}} and report the exact text of the post as displayed.

05-open: Open the opportunity record page at {{03-create.url}} and verify the following, reporting the exact on-screen values: (1) the record's Name; (2) the Account field value (should be a real link to 'Bench Account'); (3) the Stage field value; (4) the Amount field value including currency; (5) the Close Date field value (also open the field's edit mode or check the stored value to confirm the year is 2026-12-31); (6) the Assigned User field value (should be a real link to 'Bench Assignee'); (7) the Description field text; (8) the full text of any post in the {{01-signin.page_heading_1}} panel; (9) the exact record ID as it appears in the browser address bar / URL. Do not change anything — this is read-only verification.

06-report: Go to the Opportunities list view ({{02-find.filter_scope}} scope) and report the names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown, one per line. Read-only, do not modify anything. Also confirm whether the opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' appears in the list and what its stage and amount are shown as.
